newsitem.title: ITALY: Benetton Q1 sales in line, perhaps up on 96.
newsitem.headline: Benetton Q1 sales in line, perhaps up on 96.

text.p: Italian clothing group Benetton sales in the first quarter this year were "in line, if not above" those in the same 1996 period, chairman Luciano Benetton told reporters after the annual meeting.
He gave no figures but confirmed the group was studying new acquisitions including that of Benetton Sportsystem, owned like the Benetton Group by the Benetton family's Edizione Holding.

He said the group was interested in the leading sports brands of Benetton Sportsystem, which has global sales of some 1.3 trillion lire, like Rollerblade in-line skates, Nordica ski boots, Prince tennis rackets and Killer Loop, the brand name of sportswear manufacturing it recently sold.

Market sources said Goldman Sachs was acting as consultant to the seller Edizione while the buyer will likely be advised by Morgan Stanley and Italian bank IMI, joined by Salomon Brothers and Warburg who will give a fairness opinion.
A decision is expected to be made by the end of this year.
Company sources said if Benetton acquired Sportsystem it would not be quoted on the stock market.
